serp_source: Semrush execute_report phrase_organic (database=ca, 'digital marketing services'), 2026-06-18 — the live Canadian SERP.

competitor_word_counts._method: Fetched each ranking URL (seo-tools/tmp/wc-competitors.py) and counted <body> words (raw HTML incl. nav/footer; subtract ~300-500 for main-content estimate). Isolated the SERVICE-PAGE/AGENCY subset (same transactional intent as our pillar); excluded directories (designrush, agencies.semrush.com), a video (youtube), and guide-length outliers.
competitor_word_counts.length_conclusion: Service-page subset clusters ~1,700-2,700 raw HTML (~1,400-2,400 main content); thin design-led homepages run 550-1,000. A pillar that is the hub for 13 spokes should beat the thin pages decisively and sit at the substantive end without ballooning to the 6k-9k guide outliers. -> Step 4 target derived from this.

questions._source: Semrush phrase_questions (database=ca, 'digital marketing services'), filtered to BUYER intent (dropped agency-to-agency 'how to sell/pitch/price' and spam 'ai-…' variants).
buyer_questions: What are digital marketing services? / What is digital marketing services?
What is a full-service digital marketing agency?
What services do digital marketing agencies offer? / What services does a digital marketing agency provide?
How much do digital marketing services cost? (buyer-side of the high-volume 'how to price/charge' cluster)
questions.pricing_signal: Strong pricing curiosity in the SERP ('how to price/charge/how much for digital marketing services') -> the pillar must address cost honestly (transparent ranges, pricing after a free audit; never invent a price).

secondary_keywords: digital marketing services for small business
serp_features: Live SERP shows local_pack, people_also_ask, ai_overview, and video for the head terms — reinforces: include FAQ (PAA), strong local/Canadian signals, and AI-friendly structure (helps GEO).
